{
  "dataset_name": "mozilla4",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Raw duration of the event interval computed as end minus start",
      "value_range": [2.0, 1965726.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear signal capturing event span length useful for SVM margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "end - start"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed duration to compress skewed distribution of event intervals",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.5],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smoothed continuous feature reducing skew for better linear SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(end - start, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_size",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed size to normalize the heavily right-skewed size distribution",
      "value_range": [0.693, 9.42],
      "feature_family": "size",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized continuous size signal suitable for linear SVM hyperplane",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(size)"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_per_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of size to duration representing density or throughput of the event",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10000.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite ratio feature capturing interaction between size and time span for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "size / np.maximum(end - start, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_size_per_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed size-to-duration ratio for smooth density measure",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.21],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth log-ratio useful as a continuous linear projection for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(size / np.maximum(end - start, 1))"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_start",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Start time normalized by training-set max start (1936311) to range [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized temporal position useful for linear SVM without scale dominance",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "start / 1936311.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_end",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "End time normalized by training-set max end (1965726) to range [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized end position providing smooth continuous signal for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "end / 1965726.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "id_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "ID normalized by training-set max id (4088) to range [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "identifier",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized sequential identifier capturing ordering effects for linear margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "id / 4088.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "event_size_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between binary event flag and log-transformed size",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.42],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures differential size effect conditioned on event type for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "event * np.log1p(size)"
    },
    {
      "name": "event_duration_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between binary event flag and log-transformed duration",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.5],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures differential duration effect conditioned on event type for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "event * np.log1p(np.maximum(end - start, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized deviation of size from training mean (439.18) scaled by training std (952.83)",
      "value_range": [-0.46, 12.5],
      "feature_family": "size",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Z-score style normalization enabling linear SVM to use size as a well-scaled continuous feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(size - 439.18) / 952.83"
    },
    {
      "name": "temporal_coverage_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how much of the total observed time range the event interval covers, scored from 0 (very narrow interval relative to full range) to 1 (spans nearly the full observed time range), based on duration relative to max observed range of ~1965726",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Interpretable continuous severity measure of temporal span useful as a smooth linear feature for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
